details:
ASTRAQUEST – The Ultimate Space Mission Simulator

ASTRAQUEST is an interactive educational space mission simulation game designed to make space exploration and aerospace engineering more engaging and accessible. The platform allows users to take on the role of space mission directors and design their own missions, from selecting mission objectives and spacecraft components to choosing launch vehicles and planning orbital paths.

Players must work within limited budgets and carefully manage essential resources such as fuel, power, spacecraft mass, and communication systems. Every engineering decision influences the mission's performance and success. Unexpected challenges, including equipment failures, communication interruptions, and resource shortages, add realism and encourage critical thinking and problem-solving.

The game provides interactive simulations, mission progress tracking, performance scores, and detailed feedback explaining the outcomes of different decisions. By combining gaming, science, technology, and engineering concepts, ASTRAQUEST aims to help students understand the complexities of real-world space missions while inspiring the next generation of space explorers.

Our goal is to transform complex aerospace engineering concepts into an enjoyable, interactive, and educational experience.
